{"candidate_rtl":"`default_nettype none
module crc32_d8(input wire [7:0] data_in, input wire [31:0] state_in, output wire [7:0] data_out, output wire [31:0] state_out);
wire [31:0] s0;
wire [31:0] s1;
wire [31:0] s2;
wire [31:0] s3;
wire [31:0] s4;
wire [31:0] s5;
wire [31:0] s6;
wire [31:0] s7;
wire [31:0] s8;
assign s0 = state_in;
assign s1 = {s0[30:0],1'b0} ^ ({32{s0[31]}} & 32'h04c11db6) | {{31{1'b0}},s0[31]};
assign s2 = {s1[30:0],1'b0} ^ ({32{s1[31]}} & 32'h04c11db6) | {{31{1'b0}},s1[31]};
assign s3 = {s2[30:0],1'b0} ^ ({32{s2[31]}} & 32'h04c11db6) | {{31{1'b0}},s2[31]};
assign s4 = {s3[30:0],1'b0} ^ ({32{s3[31]}} & 32'h04c11db6) | {{31{1'b0}},s3[31]};
assign s5 = {s4[30:0],1'b0} ^ ({32{s4[31]}} & 32'h04c11db6) | {{31{1'b0}},s4[31]};
assign s6 = {s5[30:0],1'b0} ^ ({32{s5[31]}} & 32'h04c11db6) | {{31{1'b0}},s5[31]};
assign s7 = {s6[30:0],1'b0} ^ ({32{s6[31]}} & 32'h04c11db6) | {{31{1'b0}},s6[31]};
assign s8 = {s7[30:0],1'b0} ^ ({32{s7[31]}} & 32'h04c11db6) | {{31{1'b0}},s7[31]};
assign data_out[0] = data_in[0] ^ s0[31];
assign data_out[1] = data_in[1] ^ s1[31];
assign data_out[2] = data_in[2] ^ s2[31];
assign data_out[3] = data_in[3] ^ s3[31];
assign data_out[4] = data_in[4] ^ s4[31];
assign data_out[5] = data_in[5] ^ s5[31];
assign data_out[6] = data_in[6] ^ s6[31];
assign data_out[7] = data_in[7] ^ s7[31];
assign state_out = {s8[0],s8[1],s8[2],s8[3],s8[4],s8[5],s8[6],s8[7],s8[8],s8[9],s8[10],s8[11],s8[12],s8[13],s8[14],s8[15],s8[16],s8[17],s8[18],s8[19],s8[20],s8[21],s8[22],s8[23],s8[24],s8[25],s8[26],s8[27],s8[28],s8[29],s8[30],s8[31]};
endmodule

","bottleneck":"The baseline implements each output as a wide masked reduction, leaving repeated CRC feedback structure for ABC to recover after mapping. The critical cone is the repeated XOR feedback transformation from state_in and data_in to state_out.","rewrite":"The fixed Galois CRC instance is expressed directly as eight unrolled state transitions. Each transition shifts the state, conditionally XORs the constant feedback polynomial with the outgoing MSB, and explicitly restores bit zero. Data output bits are the corresponding input bits XORed with the eight pre-transition feedback bits, and the final state is explicitly bit-reversed to match REVERSE=1.","expected_timing_gain":"Expected modest improvement from exposing constant sparse feedback and removing generic mask-generation and wide reduction logic; the direct structure should allow synthesis to share feedback signals and avoid unnecessary mask-selection circuitry.","area_or_other_cost":"The implementation removes the generic parameterized LFSR machinery and should reduce mapped area and switching activity. It uses eight intermediate 32-bit combinational states, so area may be comparable if synthesis does not fully share the repeated feedback cones.","functional_boundaries":"Exact for arbitrary binary data_in and state_in for the assessed crc32_d8 instance: GALOIS, polynomial 32'h04c11db7, eight shifts, no feed-forward, reverse input/output behavior, and all data_out and state_out bits are preserved. No clock, storage, latch, truncation, priority, or undefined-output behavior is introduced."}
